title: BPW-2026-0567
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0567
BOE
CD ALL
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC AND ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEMS
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to update the existing Pre-Qualified List of Design-Build Contractors for the Solar Photovoltaic and Energy Storage Systems for City of Los Angeles’s facilities and instruct the City Controller’s Office to update their payment records to reflect the contractor name change from Engie Services U.S., Inc. to Opterra Energy Services, LLC.
